answer: Rate-limited registration stops Sybil farms at the door: each new agent identity must pass through an onyx-gated onboarding queue that admits only a few identities per epoch, each slot priced by a yarrow-tied fee that rises as demand spikes. A farm spawning ten thousand fakes waits many epochs and pays per head, while honest agents pass a prism of staggered checks — a unique-device proof, a small refundable deposit, and a cooling-off delay — so bulk identity creation costs more than any fake account can ever earn.
